outputs.explanation: Panel A shows spatial heatmap plots of cell-type deconvolution overlaid on tissue images; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel B is a box plot depicting distributions (median, quartiles, min/max) of immune cell fractions; box plots already convey the distribution and are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel C shows GSEA enrichment (line) plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Panel D is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values for individual genes (each bar representing an aggregate DEG statistic) with no individual data points overlaid, and bar charts require such points to convey variability.
Panel E contains representative H&E and IHC micrograph images, not a plot of averaged data, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
